data.title: 砂狼白子 · 阿拜多斯荒漠废墟的战术巡查
data.description: 阿拜多斯风沙弥漫的古代废墟神殿前，残垣断壁在无垠黄沙中静静伫立。白子双手紧握战术突击步枪警惕前行，标志性的蓝白条纹围巾在干燥狂风中猛烈猎猎作响。她神色冷峻果断，狼耳敏锐竖起捕捉远方的动静，展现出顶尖先锋突击手的凌厉气魄。
data.location: wind-blown Abydos desert ruins amidst golden sand dunes
data.action: patrolling with assault rifle, alert stance, wind sweeping striped scarf, sharp blue eyes
data.lighting: bright desert sun casting harsh shadows across golden dunes and stone ruins
data.mood: tactical vigilance, rugged frontier resilience, and solitary resolve
data.promptProse: Striding alertly through sweeping golden desert sand dunes, Sunaookami Shiroko raises her assault rifle with sharp tactical focus as wind flutters her iconic striped scarf.
data.animaCaption: Shiroko holding her assault rifle alertly amidst the windy Abydos desert ruins.
